Addison RoadWest Kensington, W14

£21,000 Pw / £91,000 Pcm (Tenant Info)
  • 7 Bedrooms
  • 7 Bathrooms
  • 3 Receptions
Enquire Map Request a Viewing Video Tour

This exceptional seven bedroom detached residence on Addison Road, W14 offers the pinnacle of luxury living just moments from the open green spaces of Holland Park. This imposing seven-bedroom home is set behind secure gates and arranged over multiple levels, boasting an abundance of natural light, generous proportions, first class leisure facilities and a seamless blend of classic elegance with contemporary design.

Addison Road is located within walking distance of Holland Park and the amenities of Kensington High Street, this is a rare opportunity to rent a truly world-class home in a highly sought-after postcode.

Security Deposit: £126,000
Council Tax Band: H
